title: Remote-ahead boundary and cross-agent audit
summary: Tightened the daily runner remote_ahead detection boundary after a manual run started from PR #124 and PR #125 landed before publish completion. The runner still blocks true stale-baseline publishing, but successful stages that merely print remote_ahead policy text no longer produce restart_latest_main. This iteration also audited the merged Codex and Claude Code PR series through PR #126 so this branch is based on current origin/main and does not drop either side's changes.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "daily runner ignores incidental remote ahead text from successful stages|daily runner turns remote ahead publish dry-run into restart latest main action" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: remote_ahead restart actions need a failure boundary, not only text matching.
lessons.evidence: A successful validation-like stage that printed remote_ahead policy text previously caused final_status blocked; the new regression test keeps the run generated_only with next_action none.
lessons.recommended_action: Only treat remote_ahead as a restart signal when the stage failed or when structured remote details prove a positive remoteAhead count.

lessons.lesson: Cross-agent merge safety should be checked from the current main tip before editing shared files.
lessons.evidence: The branch was recreated from origin/main after PR #126, and the audit compares Codex PRs #116/#120/#121/#123 with Claude Code PRs #117/#118/#119/#122/#124/#125/#126 before handoff.
lessons.recommended_action: When Codex and Claude Code both touch shared files such as src/discovery.js, tests/unit.test.js, and retrospectives/index.json, branch from the latest origin/main and audit merged file presence before continuing.

followups.action: After this fix is merged, rerun the manual daily task from latest origin/main and confirm the summary points to the actual remote-ahead stage with positive remoteAhead when another PR lands mid-run.
